title: Amazing Al Dente Chinese Pork Mu Shu
description: A malty, bouncy-qq, cozy Chinese dish featuring gherkin relish and al-dente finish, high in protein and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the pork loin strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped scallions and cook for an additional 1 minute.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and oyster sauce.
Pour the sauce mixture over the pork and scallions, and stir to combine.
Add the gherkin relish and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Warm the mu shu pancakes by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the mu shu by spooning the pork and relish mixture onto a pancake and serving immediately.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
